description.name: Entry
description.text: Restores HP (55), grants [Astra], [ATK, MAG and MND +30%], [Empower Healing 30%] and [125% Quick Cast] to all allies, grants [Crystal Force Mode] and [Crystal Force Mode: Larsa] to self

description.name: Astra
description.text: Prevents Poison, Silence, Paralyze, Confuse, Slow, Stop, Blind, Sleep, Petrify, Berserk, Sap and Stun once

description.name: Empower Healing 30%
description.text: Increases HP restored by healing by 30% (cumulative)

description.name: Crystal Force Mode
description.text: Grants Crystal Force Mode, Replaces Attack and Defend commands with Crystal Force I & II, unlocks II after three actions

description.name: Crystal Force Mode: Larsa
description.text: White Magic/Support abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00 for White Magic/Support abilities, removed if user hasn't Crystal Force Mode
